en.title: Production Planning Copilot
en.summary: Assistant that transforms product specs into optimized production plans with domain RAG and safety rails.
en.challenge: Production planners need to query schedules, facts, constraints, and operating knowledge in natural language without letting an LLM invent production data.
contribution: Designed an agentic orchestration layer that routes questions to relational, graph, or vector tools.
Built multilingual question/answer pivots, deterministic fallback behavior, seed data, and startup automation.
Containerized the complete demonstration stack with isolated API and Chainlit dependencies.
technical: Postgres stores operational facts and schedules; Neo4j represents semantic metadata and relationships.
Chroma retrieves planning documents while Ollama provides local embeddings and optional model serving.
FastAPI orchestrates Graph-to-SQL and Graph-to-Vector tools; Chainlit provides the conversational demo interface.

architecture.label: Interface
architecture.detail: Chainlit accepts multilingual planning questions and displays grounded responses.

architecture.label: Orchestration
architecture.detail: FastAPI agent classifies intent and routes work to graph, SQL, vector, or translation tools.

architecture.label: Knowledge
architecture.detail: Postgres facts, Neo4j semantics, Chroma documents, and seeded rules provide bounded context.

architecture.label: Runtime
architecture.detail: Docker Compose coordinates API, UI, databases, vector store, and local Ollama services.

outcomes: Demonstrates how LLM interaction can be grounded in operational systems rather than free-form generation.
Keeps the demo functional with deterministic templates when external model credentials are unavailable.
Separates components and ports so a second stack can run without dependency or service collisions.

zh.title: 生產規劃 Copilot
zh.summary: 以領域 RAG 與防護機制，將產品規格轉成最佳化生產計畫的助理。
zh.status: 客戶 AI 展示系統
zh.role: 生成式 AI 架構師與後端工程師
zh.challenge: 生產規劃人員需要用自然語言查詢排程、事實、限制與作業知識，同時避免大型語言模型虛構生產資料。
contribution: 設計代理式編排層，依問題將工作路由至關聯式、圖譜或向量工具。
建置多語問答轉換、確定性備援行為、種子資料與啟動自動化。
將完整展示技術堆疊容器化，並隔離 API 與 Chainlit 相依套件。
technical: Postgres 儲存營運事實與排程，Neo4j 表達語意詮釋資料與關係。
Chroma 檢索規劃文件，Ollama 提供本地嵌入與選用的模型服務。
FastAPI 編排 Graph-to-SQL 與 Graph-to-Vector 工具，Chainlit 提供對話式展示介面。

architecture.label: 介面
architecture.detail: Chainlit 接收多語規劃問題，並顯示具有依據的回覆。

architecture.label: 編排
architecture.detail: FastAPI 代理判斷意圖，並將工作路由至圖譜、SQL、向量或翻譯工具。

architecture.label: 知識
architecture.detail: Postgres 事實、Neo4j 語意、Chroma 文件與預設規則共同提供受限上下文。

architecture.label: 執行環境
architecture.detail: Docker Compose 協調 API、介面、資料庫、向量儲存與本地 Ollama 服務。

outcomes: 展示如何將 LLM 互動建立在營運系統的事實上，而非自由生成。
當外部模型憑證不可用時，仍以確定性範本維持展示功能。
分離元件與連接埠，使第二套技術堆疊也能執行而不產生相依或服務衝突。
